rationale: The WorkOS breach (Oct 30, 2026) disclosed via email before appearing on the Trust Center is a concrete, documented instance of the exact pain — B2B SaaS teams dependent on third-party auth providers learned of a critical security incident days late, with no independent detection layer. Buyers (security engineers, CTOs) already pay for vendor risk management tools (SecurityScorecard, UpGuard, Vanta), confirming willingness-to-pay in this category. The pain is severe when it occurs (potential customer data exposure, compliance failures) and structurally recurring given the growing adoption of auth-as-a-service.
